name: MiniMax
description: MiniMax's speech, image, video and music generation, run locally.
long_description:
MiniMax's own server, run as a local process on Python. It generates speech, images, video and music through their API and writes the result to this machine.

Every generation is billed to your MiniMax account.

auth.instructions: Paste a MiniMax API key from the same region as the host below — a key from one region is rejected by the other.

risk.notes: Spends your MiniMax credits and writes generated media to this machine.

MINIMAX_API_HOST.title: API host
MINIMAX_API_HOST.description: https://api.minimax.io for the global service, https://api.minimaxi.com for mainland China
